thread: The hand-drawn map with circled stones, including Sylvanas's stone

evidence.clue: Human-paper map in Kirin Tor ink with many ward-stones circled (some twice) and ruled lines from the Lordaeron side ending at circled stones. The noon stone at the dry-creek bend is circled.

Jaina explains the map: she ruled a line for each current she followed north, each ending on a stone; circled stones are bad, double-circled worse; most are on the second ring either side of the high road; one is on the outer ring east along a track beside the stones at a bend with a dry creek (the same stone Sylvanas touched). Her rangers 'have my map'.

Sylvanas, reading the map in custody, extended the ruled lines off the south edge: 'They close. Most of them cross within a mile of the Millhaven crossroads. The rest miss it by less than the width of your pen.' Jaina had never turned the rule round.

readerKnows: The map answers the Jaina-as-surveyor question: she followed currents north and marked where they end. Its lines converge on Millhaven.
povCharacterKnows: Jaina: ruled lines were drawn northward; Sylvanas ran them back and found the convergence. Jaina does not know the noon stone is wrong to Sylvanas's palm.
notes: Target-list vs survey (ch1 suspicion) is effectively settled in favour of survey from Jaina's account; Sylvanas has not said so. Whether the map had help remains unspoken.
